newsitem.title: USA: Handleman to market music via the Internet.
newsitem.headline: Handleman to market music via the Internet.

text.p: Handleman Co said on Tuesday it is giving consumers the opportunity to buy music products through the Internet.

Handleman said consumers will initially sample and order music products from a selection of more than 50,000 albums listed on the company's site on the World Wide Web. The company eventually plans to install in-store devices offering titles no longer carried in a store's inventory.
Handleman supplies music, video, books and personal software to leading retail chains across North America.
Its shares closed up 1/2 Tuesday at 8-5/8.
